# Section 4B — Affirmation Alarm (Product Deep-Dive)

## Product Overview

**Affirmation Alarm** is a mobile alarm clock for iOS that replaces the standard wake-up tone with a personalized spoken morning ritual: a greeting, goal-specific affirmations generated by AI, a closing message, and an upbeat wake-up song. The thesis is simple: the first sixty seconds of consciousness set the emotional tone for the entire day. Affirmation Alarm hijacks that window and fills it with words the user chose to hear, spoken in a voice they selected, about the goals they wrote down.

Unlike meditation apps (Calm, Headspace) that ask the user to *find* time for mindfulness, Affirmation Alarm embeds itself in an action the user already takes every single day — setting an alarm. There is no new habit to build. The user sets one alarm and wakes up to a personalized coaching experience every morning without lifting a finger.

The app is built exclusively for iOS 26+ using Apple's **AlarmKit** framework, the first-party alarm API introduced in iOS 26 that guarantees system-level alarm reliability (firing even when the app process is dead, bypassing Do Not Disturb and silent mode). This is a meaningful technical moat: AlarmKit is an iOS-only API with no Android equivalent, and building a reliable alarm experience on top of it requires solving non-trivial constraints around audio session exclusivity, background process suspension, and lock-screen widget rendering that we have already navigated.

---

## Current Beta State

Affirmation Alarm is in **active closed beta** via TestFlight. The core alarm-to-affirmation pipeline is functional:

- Users set alarms, write freeform goals, and select a TTS voice during onboarding
- AI generates fresh, non-repeating affirmations daily using the Claude API (Anthropic)
- Text-to-speech rendering via ElevenLabs produces natural spoken audio
- A pre-rendered pool of 7 morning sequences sits on-device so there is always audio ready at fire time — no network dependency at 6 AM
- The alarm fires reliably via AlarmKit, plays a brief musical chime (bundled Suno-generated track), then delivers the spoken affirmation sequence
- Stop/Snooze controls render on the lock screen via a Live Activity widget
- Snooze follow-ups play a personalized greeting + wake-up song (no repeated affirmations)
- Evening reflection prompts feed into the next morning's affirmation context
- Streak tracking, favorites, and shareable affirmation cards provide engagement loops

**Known beta limitations (in active development):**

- Lock-screen Stop/Snooze rendering depends on the user enabling Live Activities in iOS Settings; the app now detects this and prompts the user if disabled
- AlarmKit occasionally returns scheduling errors (`error 0`) on rapid re-schedule; mitigated by reconciliation logic but under investigation
- Full affirmation playback (beyond 30 seconds) requires the app process to survive overnight via background audio; a backup notification path delivers the first 30 seconds of affirmations from the lock screen even when the process is dead

Target TestFlight-to-App Store timeline: **[TBD: Corey to confirm]**

## Pricing Model

Affirmation Alarm uses a **freemium subscription model** with a single tier:

| | Free | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $0 | **$2.99/month** |
| **Trial** | — | **7-day free trial** |
| **Family Sharing** | N/A | No |
| **Alarm functionality** | Full | Full |
| **AI-personalized affirmations** | Limited / bundled fallback | Unlimited Claude-generated |
| **Voice selection** | Default voice | Full 8-voice catalog |
| **Evening reflections** | — | Included |

*Product ID: `com.cgibson.affirmationalarm.monthly`*
*Subscription Group: "Affirmation Alarm Premium"*

The $2.99/month price point is deliberately positioned below the $12.99–$14.99/month of Calm and Headspace. The value proposition is not a library of thousands of guided meditations — it is a single, effortless, daily ritual that requires zero discipline from the user. The lower price reflects the narrower scope while capturing users who have churned out of full-featured wellness apps because they never built the habit.

The 7-day free trial is critical: the product's magic is experiential. A user who wakes up to personalized affirmations three mornings in a row understands the value in a way no screenshot or marketing copy can convey. Trial-to-paid conversion is the single most important metric at launch.

**Marginal cost per subscriber:** Each alarm fire consumes one Claude API call (~$0.003–$0.008 depending on token count) and one ElevenLabs TTS call (~$0.01–$0.02 depending on character count). At daily usage, marginal API cost per subscriber is approximately **$0.50–$0.85/month**, yielding healthy unit economics at $2.99/month even before scale discounts on API pricing. **[TBD: Corey to confirm exact per-call costs at current tier]**

## Target Customer Persona

**Primary: The Goal-Driven Achiever.** Adults 22–45 who have a specific goal they're actively working toward — building a business, making a team, losing weight, becoming a better parent, leveling up in their career. They're already doing the work. Affirmation Alarm gives them a daily edge: the first words they hear every morning reinforce exactly who they're becoming and what they're chasing. These are people who read Atomic Habits, listen to Goggins, follow mindset coaches, and believe that how you start your morning determines how you show up.

**Secondary: The Inspired Beginner.** Individuals at a turning point — starting a fitness journey, leaving a toxic relationship, beginning recovery, launching a side hustle. They've decided to change their life and they're looking for tools that meet them where they are. Affirmation Alarm's goal-specific affirmations give them daily reinforcement that feels personal, not generic. The low-effort integration (just set an alarm) matters here — these users are building new habits and can't afford another app that requires discipline to use.

**Tertiary: The Daily Optimizer.** Self-improvement enthusiasts who stack habits, track metrics, and optimize their routines. They're drawn to the AI personalization, the non-repeating content, and the evening reflection → morning affirmation feedback loop. These users are vocal sharers — the affirmation card sharing feature is designed for this cohort to drive organic growth.

**Common thread:** These are not passive consumers of wellness content. They are people in motion — working, building, grinding, healing. Affirmation Alarm doesn't ask them to slow down and meditate. It rides alongside what they're already doing and amplifies it.

## Key Differentiators

**1. Zero-effort integration.** No new habit required. Set an alarm once — the ritual happens automatically every morning. This is the fundamental product insight and the reason Affirmation Alarm can reach users who would never open a meditation app.

**2. AI-personalized, non-repeating content.** Every morning's affirmations are freshly generated by Claude, anchored to the user's specific goals, with an anti-repetition system that feeds prior affirmations as an exclusion list. The user never hears the same line twice. This is not a library of pre-written content — it is a generative system that evolves with the user.

**3. Dual-voice AI personality.** The affirmation prompt produces a deliberate mix of two tones — bold champion energy ("Your bat speed is a weapon. Trust it.") and warm mentor wisdom ("The hours you put in when nobody's watching — they're showing up in your swing now.") — alternating within the same morning. This emotional texture is a differentiator against apps that offer only one register.

**4. Shared HSH Voice Catalog.** Affirmation Alarm ships with an 8-voice catalog powered by ElevenLabs: Rachel (calm & confident), Drew (warm & assured), Sarah (soft & encouraging), Matilda (warm & nurturing), Brian (deep & grounded), Daniel (deep & authoritative), Lily (warm & British), and Chris (casual & friendly). As the Healthy Soul Healing portfolio expands, this voice catalog becomes a shared asset across Resonance Healing and InnerEdge Pro — a user who bonds with "Matilda" in Affirmation Alarm encounters the same voice in their Resonance sound healing sessions, creating cross-product familiarity and reducing churn across the portfolio.

**5. System-level alarm reliability.** Built on Apple's AlarmKit (iOS 26+), Affirmation Alarm fires with the same reliability as the native Clock app — bypassing silent mode, Do Not Disturb, and Focus modes. This is table-stakes for an alarm app but a meaningful engineering barrier for competitors attempting to build on older notification-based approaches.

## App Store Launch Go-to-Market

**Phase 1 — Soft launch (Week 1–4):**
Invite-only TestFlight beta with 50–100 users recruited from Instagram, TikTok mindset communities, and Corey's personal network. Goal: validate trial-to-paid conversion, collect qualitative feedback on affirmation quality, identify device-specific bugs.

**Phase 2 — App Store submission (Week 4–6):**
Submit to App Store Review with App Store Optimization (ASO) targeting keywords: "affirmation alarm," "morning alarm," "positive alarm," "motivational alarm," "self talk alarm." Primary screenshot set emphasizes the lock-screen experience (affirmations playing with Stop/Snooze visible). App Preview video shows the 60-second wake-up experience.

**Phase 3 — Organic growth (Week 6–12):**
Leverage the shareable affirmation card feature (renders a branded image card from any affirmation, shareable to Instagram Stories, TikTok, X) as the primary organic growth loop. Each shared card includes the Affirmation Alarm brand mark. Supplement with TikTok content showing real morning wake-ups.

**Phase 4 — Paid acquisition (Month 3+):**
Apple Search Ads targeting alarm-related and self-improvement keywords. Budget: **[TBD: Corey to confirm]**. Target CPA must remain below 3× monthly subscription price ($8.97) assuming [TBD: Corey to confirm] month average retention.

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Platform** | iOS 26.5+, Swift 6, SwiftUI | Native app, strict concurrency |
| **Alarm** | AlarmKit | System-level alarm scheduling and firing |
| **Lock screen** | ActivityKit / Live Activities | Stop/Snooze buttons, Dynamic Island |
| **Persistence** | SwiftData | User profiles, affirmation history, alarms |
| **AI Generation** | Claude API (Anthropic) | Personalized affirmation text generation |
| **Text-to-Speech** | ElevenLabs API | Natural-sounding spoken affirmations |
| **Audio** | AVAudioEngine, AVAudioPlayer | Playback, volume control, intro chimes |
| **Background** | UIBackgroundModes (audio) | Keep-alive for overnight process survival |
| **Wake-up Music** | Bundled Suno-generated tracks | Musical alarm sounds + post-affirmation songs |
| **Crash Reporting** | Sentry | Production error monitoring |
| **CI/CD** | Codemagic | Build, archive, TestFlight distribution |
| **Project Gen** | XcodeGen | Reproducible Xcode project from YAML |

## Cross-Portfolio Fit

Affirmation Alarm is the **daily touchpoint** in the Healthy Soul Healing portfolio. While Resonance Healing sessions happen a few times per week and InnerEdge Pro coaching engages on a weekly or monthly cadence, Affirmation Alarm touches the user *every single morning*. This makes it:

1. **The top-of-funnel acquisition product.** At $2.99/month with a 7-day free trial, Affirmation Alarm has the lowest barrier to entry in the portfolio. A user who downloads Affirmation Alarm for the alarm feature and bonds with the AI-generated affirmation experience is pre-qualified for Resonance Healing's deeper sound therapy sessions and InnerEdge Pro's structured coaching programs.

2. **The engagement anchor.** Daily alarm usage produces the highest-frequency engagement metric across the portfolio. A user who stops opening Resonance might still wake up to Affirmation Alarm every morning — maintaining the HSH relationship and providing a re-engagement surface for cross-sell messaging.

3. **The shared-voice bridge.** The ElevenLabs voice catalog (8 voices at launch) is designed to be shared across all three products. A user who wakes up to Matilda's warm voice every morning for three months has an emotional relationship with that voice. When they encounter Matilda narrating a Resonance sound healing session, the familiarity creates immediate trust and comfort — a subtle but powerful cross-product retention mechanism.

4. **The data flywheel.** Affirmation Alarm collects the user's goals, evening reflections, mood data (via the reflection flow), and engagement patterns (streak length, snooze frequency, favorite affirmations). With appropriate consent, this data can personalize the Resonance and InnerEdge experiences — a sound healing session that references the user's stated goals, or a coaching prompt that builds on their morning affirmation themes.

## Key Risks

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **Apple AlarmKit API changes** | High | AlarmKit is new (iOS 26); Apple could change APIs in iOS 27. We monitor WWDC announcements and maintain a notification-based fallback path. |
| **ElevenLabs pricing increases** | Medium | TTS is the largest marginal cost. We can switch to OpenAI TTS (already implemented as a fallback) or Apple's on-device speech synthesis at reduced quality. |
| **Claude API reliability/cost** | Medium | Bundled affirmation fallback ensures alarms always work even during API outages. Claude costs are manageable at current scale; may need to negotiate volume pricing above [TBD: Corey to confirm] subscribers. |
| **App Store rejection** | Medium | AlarmKit apps require specific entitlements and usage descriptions. We comply with all documented requirements. The alarm-as-wellness framing is novel and may require explanation during review. |
| **User churn after trial** | High | The 7-day trial must deliver 3+ "wow" mornings. Affirmation quality (Claude prompt engineering) and voice quality (ElevenLabs) are the primary levers. Churn rate assumption: **[TBD: Corey to confirm]**. |
| **Background process reliability** | Medium | iOS can kill background processes overnight, degrading the full affirmation experience to a 30-second notification sound. The backup notification path with Stop/Snooze actions ensures users always wake up and hear personalized audio regardless. |
| **Competitive response** | Low | Calm/Headspace could add alarm features, but their business model is content-library subscriptions — bolting on an alarm is a feature, not a product. Our moat is the zero-effort daily integration + AI personalization engine. |
| **Platform lock-in (iOS only)** | Medium | AlarmKit has no Android equivalent. Android expansion would require a fundamentally different architecture. Near-term, iOS-only is acceptable given the target demographic's platform distribution. |
